candidates.title: The Pool That Emptied at High Tide
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the coastal nursery's tidal pool drained whenever the tide rose during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they piled stones around its rim but the water still vanished; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a submerged siphon tube connected the pool to a lower drainage trench; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they capped the unintended siphon and restored a safe overflow channel, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Seeds That Sprouted Out of Order
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the school garden's dated seed trays germinated in the reverse of their planting schedule during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they replanted the oldest trays but the sequence remained wrong; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized warmth from a buried heating pipe reached the newest trays first; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they moved the trays to equal temperatures and updated the planting schedule, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Window That Sang at Noon
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the clinic's glass window made a piercing tone each midday during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they padded the window frame but the sound continued; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized sunlight heated an exposed metal vent that vibrated against the glass; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they installed a flexible spacer and checked the ventilation airflow, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
